cvEn:
Benyamin Rostoker, son of Klara and David, was born on 9 Shevat 5711 (16 January 1951) in Ramat Gan. He attended the Kmmoiyut elementary school and the ORT vocational high school in Givatayim. In his youth he was a member of the Scouts movement, and he often went on trips with his fellow members to all parts of the country.

His friends were very fond of him and respected him, for he was a true friend and a loyal companion, clean-handed and good-hearted. He was an outstanding athlete and played on the youth basketball team of Hapoel Bnei Brak. Apart from sports, Benyamin devoted much time to another hobby: listening to music on records.

In his short life, Benyamin was known as an upright boy, resourceful and intelligent. Before his conscription he studied at the Air Force technical school in Haifa and qualified as an electronics technician. In February 1969 he was drafted into the IDF and volunteered for the Air Force. On 22 Sivan 5729 (8 June 1969), only four months later, he lost his life while performing his duty. He was buried in the military cemetery in Kiryat Shaul.
